recap.headline: Duncairn Harbour Come From Behind To Beat Kestrel Vale
recap.summary: Kestrel Vale started strongly at Vale Meadow, taking the lead through Mateo Tavrelle in the 24th minute after an earlier momentum shift. The match turned dramatically when Felix Montaval received a red card for Kestrel Vale in the 32nd minute. Duncairn Harbour capitalized on their advantage, as Samir Esperon scored two crucial goals to secure a 1-2 victory.
turning_points: 32' Felix Montaval receives a red card leaving Kestrel Vale with ten men.
58' Samir Esperon scores the equalizer to level the match at 1-1.
78' Samir Esperon scores his second goal to complete the 1-2 comeback for Duncairn Harbour.
